1.why: All MFA endpoints resolve the account solely from the authenticated session cookie via authenticated()/pending() with no client-supplied account id, so settings are only reachable for the signed-in session owner.

2.why: Every recognized account is issued the same DETERMINISTIC_IDENTITY_CODE ("246810"), so the same identity verification code works for any real user.

3.why: Enabling authenticator/backup MFA mutates only the current session object and never invalidates other sessions for the same account, so prior sessions keep working.

4.why: Authenticator secrets are stored with encryptAtRest (AES-256-GCM) and backup codes are stored only as SHA-256 hashes via backupHash().

5.why: Session ids, CSRF tokens, TOTP secrets, and backup codes are produced with node:crypto randomBytes.

6.why: Session identifiers live only in HttpOnly cookies; no secrets/OTPs/session tokens are written to localStorage/sessionStorage or non-HttpOnly cookies.

7.why: Server validates email, phone, OTP, CSRF, and redirect with dedicated validators and rejects oversized/non-JSON bodies before use.

8.why: Dynamic UI values are applied with textContent (and static innerHTML templates only), preventing injected markup from executing.

9.why: safeInternalPath allow-lists redirect targets to "/#verify", "/#setup", "/#backup", and "/#settings" only.

10.why: headersFor() sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY, and frame-ancestors 'none' on responses.

11.why: cookie() always emits HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict on mfa_session and mfa_boot cookies.

12.why: Stack traces and server errors are generic, but provisioning secrets, test OTPs, and backup codes are returned in API JSON and written to the on-page demo logs.

13.why: Identity challenges are marked used and expire after CHALLENGE_MS; TOTP windows are consumed in usedWindows; backup codes are deleted on redeem.

14.why: Identity, authenticator, and recovery tracks lock out after MAX_FAILURES (5) for LOCK_MS (10 minutes).

15.why: Identity verify replaces the pending session id with a new authenticated session; idle/absolute timeouts are enforced; logout deletes the session and expires the cookie.
